verse.name: v1a
verse.lines:
Give thanks to the Lord
our God and King
His love endures forever

verse.name: v1b
verse.lines:
For He is good
He is above all things
His love endures forever

verse.name: v2a
verse.lines:
With a mighty hand
and outstretched arm
His love endures forever

verse.name: v2b
verse.lines:
For the life that's been reborn
His love endures forever

verse.name: p2
verse.lines:
Sing praise, sing praise
Sing praise, sing praise

verse.name: c1
verse.lines:
Forever God is faithful
Forever God is strong
Forever God is with us
Forever, forever

verse.name: v3a
verse.lines:
From the rising
To the setting sun
His love endures forever

verse.name: v3b
verse.lines:
By the grace of God,
We will carry on
His love endures forever

verse.name: p3
verse.lines:
Sing praise, sing praise
Sing praise, sing praise
